sources.entry: Readest - Open-source ebook reader with a clean interface and powerful reading tools. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/readest/readest) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Readest - Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers.

summary.one_liner: Readest is an open-source, cross-platform ebook reader built as a modern rewrite of Foliate, using Next.js and Tauri v2.
summary.what_it_does: Readest reads EPUB, PDF, MOBI, KF8 (AZW3), FB2, CBZ, TXT, HTML and Markdown files, with scroll or paginated views. It offers full-text search within a book or across a library shelf, plus highlights, bookmarks and notes. Built-in or imported dictionaries (including Yomitan ZIP/RDICT) and Wikipedia lookup are available, along with DeepL and Yandex translation. It also supports text-to-speech, audiobook playback, EPUB 3 read-along narration, OPDS/Calibre catalog access, and web page clipping. Sync of books, progress, notes and bookmarks across platforms and with KOReader is described in the README.
use_cases: read ebooks on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS or the web
read PDFs, EPUBs and comics in one app
listen to books with text-to-speech or narration
browse an OPDS or Calibre library
read two documents side by side
how_to_run: macOS, iOS and iPadOS: install Readest from the App Store
Windows, Linux, Android: download from the Readest website or GitHub Releases
Linux: install from Flathub (flatpak run com.bilingify.readest)
Web: use Readest for Web in a browser
notable: Modern rewrite of the Foliate ebook reader
Read-along narration: plays EPUB 3 Media Overlays with timed highlighting, or pairs an EPUB with local DRM-free MP3/M4A/M4B audio
Sync with KOReader for reading progress, notes and bookmarks
Parallel Read split-screen view for two documents
Web novel and web page clipping that can reuse a browser session
caveats: Linux builds use CEF with an X11 backend, so Wayland sessions need XWayland
Nix package supports x86_64-linux only; nix-darwin is not supported
Windows needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime installed
Handwriting annotations, AI summarization and advanced reading stats are listed as planned or in progress
